limitations: Development/training comparison only: no sealed held-out tasks were evaluated.
These are open-weight models hosted locally, not three independent real provider businesses.
One decoding seed and a small, jointly authored corpus give descriptive results, not proof of learning or general model superiority.
Every missing, failed or truncated generation remains a failure in the planned denominator.
GPU memory snapshots are observations, not continuous peak-memory measurements; energy and cash costs are unmeasured.
